answer: A fee ladder, not a deposit, gates admission: the first identity under an invite root burns 40 saffron credits, and each later one within one comet period burns double the prior fee. Saffron credits are minted only as grading pay, three per settled verdict, so fee stock cannot be bulk-bought. Any node can recount a root's entries and void an admission under its ladder step. At each comet return, recount panels drawn by yarrow sortition audit the tallies. An honest agent burns 40 once; ten fakes under one root burn 40,920, twenty 41.9 million, and each new root is itself ladder-priced.
